name: color-contrast-checker
description: Check your colour tokens against WCAG contrast rules and fix the pairs that are hard to read. Open your CSS, SCSS or JSON design tokens: text-on-background pairs are found from your CSS rules and token names (including dark-theme overrides and var() chains), or you list them yourself. Every pair shows its ratio and AA/AAA result, with the nearest passing colour — same hue, just lighter or darker — as a suggested fix. Accept fixes or type your own colour, see every pair re-checked, then export fixed token files and a report. Runs locally; no upload or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 按 WCAG 对比度标准检查配色变量，修正看不清的组合。打开 CSS、SCSS 或 JSON 设计令牌，会根据 CSS 规则和变量名（包括深色主题覆盖和 var() 引用）找出文字和背景的组合，也可以自己列。每组显示对比度和 AA/AAA 结果，并给出最接近的达标颜色（色相不变，只调深浅）。接受修正或填自己的颜色，所有组合会重新检查，最后导出修正后的令牌文件和报告。在本地运行，不上传，无需 API 密钥。
